title: Quantum-Group and Affine-Hecke Solutions of Boundary qKZ Equations
exact_target: Relate boundary qKZ solutions built by quantum groups or q-integrals to the affine-Hecke basis selected by chamber asymptotics.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002802 (OWR-13495-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Coideal Subalgebras of Quantum Groups (2015), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2015/10, pp. 533--569. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 31.

status_qualification: This comparison depends on matching parameters, normalizations and analytic domains of the two constructions; an arbitrary basis identification is not the requested relation.
